title: MySQL/MariaDB
description: Connections, queries, slow queries, traffic, InnoDB buffer pool and replication, with a user that has PROCESS and REPLICATION CLIENT.

address.title: Address
address.description: host:port of the server (loopback, localhost and port 3306 unless module_targets, module_hosts and module_ports of agent.toml allow more).

user.title: User
user.description: A user with PROCESS and REPLICATION CLIENT (MariaDB: REPLICA MONITOR) and nothing more.

tls.title: TLS
tls.description: off, verify (the certificate against the system's CAs or ca_file), no_verify (any certificate: encrypted, but to whoever answers). Empty: off on loopback and the socket, verify for any other address. The full login of caching_sha2_password (first login, after a restart) sends the password and needs the socket or verify.

ca_file.title: CA file
ca_file.description: PEM file below module_file_prefixes to verify the server's certificate with instead of the system's CAs (tls verify), e.g. MySQL's own ca.pem copied there.
